anomalies.expected: For reverse-polarity protection, the P-channel MOSFET should have its drain connected to the input and its source connected to the output, so the body diode blocks reverse current. The specification states the board includes reverse polarity protection.

evidence.quote: README states the PCB includes "reverse polarity protection, TVS diodes, proper isolation"

anomalies.impact: Reverse input polarity will forward-bias the P-channel MOSFET body diode and pull the +24V rail negative, potentially damaging downstream components. The intended reverse-polarity protection is ineffective.

parsed.summary: The design files contain a reversed P-channel MOSFET (T4) in the 24 V input path, defeating the intended reverse-polarity protection. Other reviewed functions appear consistent with the specification.
